target_forcefield: CHARMM36 additive plus compatible CGenFF terms

requirements: the product minimum and complete d(TpT) reference are hash-pinned
one rigid proper rotation and translation is applied to the complete two-base product with no reflection or endpoint swap
all sugar and phosphate coordinates remain identical to the selected reference
the complete product-base internal distance matrix remains identical to the audited QM minimum
the SDF, XYZ, and stable atom map encode exactly 63 atoms, formal charge -1, both glycosidic bonds, the phosphodiester, terminal caps, and the selected product crosslinks
all four product signed-volume stereocenters retain their declared sign
glycosidic and product-crosslink bond lengths remain within catastrophic-input bounds
nonbonded heavy atoms have no severe covalent-radius overlap
two independently extracted 1N4E sugar/phosphate references agree after product grafting and proper-rotation alignment

anchor_rmsd_angstrom.role: Rigid-graft compatibility screen, not an equilibrium-geometry target.

glycosidic_bond_length_angstrom.reference: Pinned CHARMM36 CN7B-NN2B equilibrium distance is 1.458 angstrom; the wider interval is only a catastrophic QM-input screen.

minimum_nonbonded_covalent_radius_ratio.role: PoseBusters-style severe-overlap screen excluding bonded and 1-3 pairs.
